answer: Re-attestations are stored in comet and canyon lists each lapse. Standing lapses unless 4 peers re-attest it every 18 epochs, so holding a position requires ongoing relationships rather than a one-time purchase. A farm cannot self-supply those because the attesters must be independent on the cipher graph. Because every step is charged to the account that performs it, 766 impostors cost 510 times the honest price and take 17 times as long to clear. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
